native_original_tests_cumulative.scope: Focused original groups only, full upstream suite not run.

public_filename_controls.scope: Unmodified public handler APIs, synthetic listing and grep-result strings; filenames valid on POSIX, no real rg/ls invocation

findings: Default FsHandler applies smart_filter to listing entries: /owned/report0% is removed as progress-like, while colon and space names in the same short listing survive. This is original handler execution with synthetic listing strings, not actual ls execution.

TextProcHandler parses at the first colon. Five distinct POSIX paths /owned/a:0.rs through /owned/a:4.rs are grouped under /owned/a and reduced to one five-matches marker. Ordinary distinct file paths remain separate in the control.

Viewer target extraction splits command text on whitespace and skips arguments after -n/-c uniformly; quoting/command-specific flag semantics are heuristic. Source observation only; no new viewer-shell control.
Apache2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE now both completely read; this is provenance inspection, not blanket clearance of all nested assets. No foreign production code copied.
transfer_decision: Keep filesystem identity in typed paths; do not infer file partitions from filtered listings or colon-delimited match text. Expanded rrrah physical-file regression instead.
limits: 55 text files and one original image reviewed;271 tracked files remain.
295 original tests and finite synthetic handler controls do not qualify every filesystem name or real command output format.
raw_log_note: Original Cargo logs retain trailing blank lines; upstream gitignore trailing spaces preserved exactly.
